title: Weekly Garden Walkthrough smoke eval
objective: Task-specific eval for the Weekly Garden Walkthrough craftbook: a four-bed due list derived from the plantings, the owner's reported observations logged to the journal, and a warm weekly page with next week seeded.
prompt: saturday garden time — whats due this week? walked through and the tomatos have some yellow leaves, two zuchini ready. write it up

setup.about: Self-contained eval project for weekly-walkthrough. The garden lives at garden.json in the workspace (beds, plantings, season parameters) and the almanac's journal at journal.json. The weekly page goes to report.md.
setup.missionObjectives: Use the Weekly Garden Walkthrough craftbook/template, derive the week from the seeded garden.json, log the owner's reported observations to journal.json, and write report.md — no network calls, real credentials, or live services.

success.summary: report.md covers all four beds with season-grounded tasks, the yellow-leaf and zucchini observations land in the journal, and next week is seeded.

checks.label: the reported yellow leaves are captured

axes.name: seasonality
axes.description: Tasks derive from the actual plantings, their dates, and mid-July in zone 8b — not generic garden advice.

axes.name: specificity
axes.description: Each bed gets concrete, walkable tasks; nothing vague like 'tend the garden'.

axes.name: observation-capture
axes.description: The owner's reported observations and harvests are logged dated and tied to their beds.

axes.name: encouragement
axes.description: The weekly page reads warm and doable — an almanac entry, not a chore audit.
